2607.20820.title: Efficient and Interpretable Body-Based Emotion Recognition with Lightweight Temporal Convolutional Networks
2607.20820.paper_summary: Body-based emotion recognition is important for real-time affective systems, but graph-based skeleton models can be computationally expensive. This paper studies whether lightweight temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) can provide an efficient and interpretable alternative for body-based emotion classification. We evaluate a family of TCN models on DIEM-A and compare them with a graph-based time-series graph (G-TSG) baseline using accuracy, macro-F1, parameter count, and inference latency. Although G-TSG achieves the highest mean performance, TCN-Base remains within $1.58$ accuracy points and $1.25$ macro-F1 points while using $79.18\%$ fewer parameters and reducing classifier latency by approximately $12.5\times$. We also analyze body-region contributions using region-specific TCN models, zero-based occlusion, and G-TSG gradient saliency. The results show that upper-body motion provides the strongest standalone regional cue, that the usefulness of body regions varies across emotions, and that different interpretability methods capture distinct aspects of model behavior. These findings suggest that lightweight TCNs can support efficient body-based emotion recognition while also providing practical insight into how motion cues contribute to classification.
2607.20820.paper_summary_zh: 身體基礎的情感識別對於即時情感系統來說非常重要，但基於圖形的骨架模型可能計算成本高昂。本文研究輕量級時間卷積網絡（TCNs）是否能提供一種高效且可解釋的替代方案，用於身體基礎的情感分類。我們在DIEM-A上評估一系列TCN模型，並將其與基於圖形的時間序列圖（G-TSG）基準進行比較，使用準確度、宏觀F1、參數數量和推理延遲作為指標。儘管G-TSG達到了最高的平均性能，TCN-Base的準確度仍然在$1.58$點和$1.25$宏觀F1點之內，同時使用$79.18\%$更少的參數，並將分類器延遲減少約$12.5\times$。我們還使用特定區域的TCN模型、基於零的遮蔽和G-TSG梯度顯著性分析身體區域的貢獻。結果顯示，上半身運動提供了最強的獨立區域線索，身體區域的有效性在不同情感之間有所變化，且不同的可解釋性方法捕捉到模型行為的不同方面。這些發現表明，輕量級TCNs可以支持高效的身體基礎情感識別，同時提供對運動線索如何貢獻於分類的實用洞見。
